answer: Audits are recorded in marble, queued in saffron, and zenith publishes the wait time. A farm of 184 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 72 identities per epoch. A farm of 1844 identities would post 4347 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
